strings.dockHeading: In every lesson: the teach dock
strings.dockLead: Open any current lesson and tap the TEACH pill at the bottom of the screen. A floating dock brings the classroom essentials to you, with no tab-switching and no losing the room.

dock.title: Quick Timer
dock.text: 1, 5 or 10 minutes overlaid on the corner of your slides. No jarring alarm, just a gentle pulse at zero.

dock.title: Name Picker
dock.text: Paste your class list once. It follows you into every lesson and won't repeat until everyone has had a turn.

dock.title: Noise Meter
dock.text: A live volume visualiser using this device's mic only. Nothing is ever recorded or uploaded.

dock.title: Calm Reset
dock.text: One tap replaces the screen with a slow breathing guide. Connection before correction, then tap to return.
